div.div: سَنْدَانٌ , with fet-h, (Mgh, Msb, K,) or ↓ سِنْدَانٌ , (thus in a copy of the M, [and thus I have generally found it written, agreeably with the common modern pronunciation,]) The عَلَاة, (M,) or زُبْرَة, (Msb,) [both meaning anvil,] of the blacksmith. (Msb, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
